content.title: AI-enabled gas sensors for breath-based diagnostics: smart mask platforms toward personalized healthcare
content.abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) with breath-based gas detection is paving the way for promising advances in noninvasive diagnostics at the point of care. Specific volatile organic compounds (VOCs) in exhaled human breath act as biomarkers of several diseases. However, accurate breath analysis remains challenging because VOC concentrations vary from parts per billion (ppb) to parts per million (ppm).
